clue.text: Underworld treaties cause arguments

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
treaties are formal agreements between states

explanation.surface: Pacts made in the criminal underworld lead to quarrels.
explanation.definitionFit: Quarrels and disputes are what people have when they fail to concur.

clue.text: The first epistle

parts.note: an epistle is a letter, and the first letter of a name or word is its capital opening one

explanation.surface: A reference to the opening letter of the New Testament epistles.
explanation.definitionFit: The opening letter of a name is called this, punning on epistle as a letter of the alphabet.

clue.text: A police force is sharp

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: A remark that a particular constabulary is quick-witted.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp and sour in taste or tone are synonyms of this adjective.

clue.text: Medium — sized soldier

definitions.meaning: a ... size is the standard, middling one
a professional soldier in the standing army

explanation.surface: A soldier of average build.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard middling portion is called this, and so is a full-time professional in the army.

clue.text: Relax after the day before going up the mountain

indicators.note: after places the word for relax behind the word for the day before

parts.note: eve is the day before a festival, as in Christmas Eve
to relax is to rest

explanation.surface: Take a breather on the eve of a big climb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up' is a link suiting the climbing picture; it does not reverse anything.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's highest peak, in the Himalaya.

clue.text: Correct some of the drafted Italian newspapers

indicators.note: some of signals that only part of the following run of letters is wanted

explanation.surface: Fixing a portion of the Italian press that was drafted.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct text is to revise it for publication.

clue.text: Support the French after very traumatic start

indicators.note: after sends the word for the French to the end, behind the other pieces

parts.note: tres is French for very

indicators.note: start asks for the opening letter of traumatic

parts.note: le is a French word for the

explanation.surface: Someone needing support after a shocking opening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'very' looks like an intensifier for 'traumatic', but it is a French word supplying letters of its own.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a supporting frame, as under a table top.

clue.text: While walking around the queen is upstaged into making an introduction

indicators.note: upstaged means the two letters for the queen swap so the second goes up front

parts.note: perambulating means walking about
ER is the royal cipher, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A royal is overshadowed while strolling about during her opening speech.
explanation.walkthrough: In the word for walking around, ER becomes RE.
explanation.definitionFit: A preamble is an introduction, so this is opening with prefatory remarks.

clue.text: Do they figure things out?

parts.note: read figure as working with numbers: people who crunch data

explanation.surface: Asking who solves problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Experts in data analysis work out figures for a living.

clue.text: Soundly controlling falling water

indicators.note: soundly signals that the word for controlling is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: reigning means ruling or controlling

explanation.surface: Firmly governing a waterfall.
explanation.definitionFit: Precipitation coming down is weather of this kind.

clue.text: Obvious diet nev digested

indicators.note: digested suggests food broken down and processed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something plain about a diet being digested.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain and clear to see are synonyms.

clue.text: Colour of regular pain pills

indicators.note: regular asks for every other letter, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: The hue of painkillers taken routinely.
explanation.definitionFit: Anil is indigo, a blue dye from a plant.

clue.text: Ancestor's tree

definitions.meaning: an older forebear, with the 's read as is
a small tree with white flowers and black berries

explanation.surface: Asking about a family tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Forebears are senior family members, and the shrub bearing elderberries shares the name.

clue.text: Restore stencilling through editing the initials

indicators.note: initials asks for the first letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: An editor restoring stencilled lettering.
explanation.definitionFit: A proofreader's instruction meaning let the deleted text stand, i.e. reinstate it.

clue.text: Michael, for instance, is no longer in beer

parts.note: St Michael is an example of a saint, abbreviated ST
someone no longer in is out

explanation.surface: A man named Michael is past his prime at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark strong ale is a type of beer.

clue.text: Simon starts to ram down mint

indicators.note: starts asks for the opening letter of Simon

parts.note: to tamp is to pack down firmly

explanation.surface: Simon begins pressing down some herbs.
explanation.definitionFit: To mint coins is to strike or impress them with a die.

clue.text: Does it hold up the frisky lobster?

indicators.note: frisky suggests lively movement, so the letters jump into a new order

explanation.surface: Asking whether a lively crustacean props something up.
explanation.definitionFit: A long pillow or cushion supports; as a verb it means prop up.

clue.text: Sways like tense animals

parts.note: T is the grammar abbreviation for tense
otters are aquatic animals

explanation.surface: Nervous creatures rocking from side to side.
explanation.definitionFit: Wobbling unsteadily is swaying.

clue.text: Make-up raquel paints over original cosmetic gloss

indicators.note: make-up read as making up a new arrangement of letters
original asks for the first letter of cosmetic

explanation.surface: Raquel applies cosmetics over her original lip gloss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make-up' looks like cosmetics but is the anagram signal; 'paints over' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard shiny varnish gives a glossy coat.

clue.text: Noisy crew's hesitation on a warship

indicators.note: noisy signals the word is taken as heard

parts.note: the crew's, belonging to the crew
er is a hesitant sound in speech

explanation.surface: Sailors' pause aboard a loud naval vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A fast warship, smaller than a battleship.

clue.text: Knocking sound caused by rodent eating a lot of odds and ends

indicators.note: eating means the word for rodent takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a rat is a rodent
tat is cheap bits and pieces

explanation.surface: A rat chewing through junk makes a tapping noise.
explanation.walkthrough: ATAT goes after the R of RAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Imitative word for repeated rapping, as on a door.

clue.text: Great show by eastern team, but it was buried in 79ad

parts.note: pomp is splendid display
a side of eleven, written II in Roman figures

explanation.surface: A grand display by an eastern side, with an ancient burial.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman city was covered by Vesuvius's eruption that year.

clue.text: If use stapler incorrectly, may need one of these

definitions.text: If use stapler incorrectly, may need one of these

indicators.note: incorrectly suggests the letters are put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A warning that misusing a stapler can injure a finger.
explanation.definitionFit: A sticking plaster covers a small wound.

clue.text: He's vain — so may die away poetically

indicators.note: so may hints that these letters may in turn become something else

explanation.surface: A conceited man may fade away, in verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary word for vanishing.

clue.text: Greek character began to be drawn

parts.note: tau is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: began asks for the first letter of to

explanation.surface: A Greek figure started to be sketched.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulled tight is tense, as a drawn face is strained.

clue.text: Some beef tea in Saskatchewan

indicators.note: in places the drink within the abbreviation for the province

parts.note: SK is the postal abbreviation for the Canadian province

explanation.surface: Beef tea served in a Canadian province.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut of beef for grilling.

clue.text: Run a cab

definitions.meaning: an aircraft runs along the ground before takeoff

explanation.surface: Ordering someone to hurry to a cab.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft moving on the runway does this; a hackney carriage is another name.

clue.text: Live graduate on the rostrum

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the first piece above the second

parts.note: to live is to be
MA is a Master of Arts graduate

explanation.surface: A graduate living at the speaker's platform.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised platform in a synagogue or ancient Greek assembly.

clue.text: Sloth caused by uranium atoms absorbing sodium

indicators.note: absorbing means the two uranium letters take sodium inside

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium, and atoms in the plural gives two
Na is the chemical symbol for sodium

explanation.surface: Laziness from a chemical reaction.
explanation.definitionFit: The two-toed tree sloth of South America.

clue.text: Beginning to develop the knight's advancement

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight
an ascent is a rise or advance

explanation.surface: A chess knight's move forward starting out.
explanation.definitionFit: Emerging and coming into being.

clue.text: One isn't properly treated for strain

indicators.note: properly treated suggests the letters are worked on into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone not being treated right ends up stressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Tautness and stress are synonyms.

clue.text: Those eureka moments!

parts.note: the instant of sudden discovery, when a problem finally gives way

explanation.surface: Celebrating moments of sudden insight.
explanation.definitionFit: Major discoveries are moments of insight.
